heading.title: Of the Duties of an Executor or Administrator

article.title: Non-abatement of specific legacy when assets sufficient to pay debts.
article.content:
328Non-abatement of specific legacy when assets sufficient to pay debts.

Section 328  ·  Part IX · Chapter VII  ·  page 85 of the Act
Where there is a specific legacy, and the assets are sufficient for the payment of debts and necessary expenses, the thing specified must be delivered to the legatee without any abatement.
